record_title: Projective-overlap budget for direct support tau-tilting induction
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The exact overlap-budget criterion was not found in targeted searches, but the structural zero-overlap/radical observation uses classical Morita-context and semisimple-ring facts and is not claimed as a historical first. The full text of Sands (1973) was not inspected. Computing the two cross-corner duplicate terms can itself require isomorphism recognition. A concurrent revision of the very recent source preprint or an independent observation is possible. No independent validation is asserted.
